semiconductor_relevance: High — TST Semiconductor is actively involved in the sale and purchase of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and materials, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor industry.
summary: TST Semiconductor Co., Ltd. specializes in the sale and purchase of both new and used semiconductor manufacturing equipment, alongside providing installation, technology provision, and after-sales maintenance services. The company also offers a range of semiconductor materials, including compound semiconductor materials and MBE equipment.
capabilities: Sales and installation of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment
Refurbishing and maintenance of semiconductor manufacturing equipment
Sales of compound semiconductor materials and MBE equipment
Provision of special gases for semiconductor processes

regional_presence.Japan: TST Semiconductor was established in Japan as a business base for its operations.
